svg.title: Certificate issuance and AGIC reconciliation
svg.desc: cert-manager issues aks-store-demo/store-front-tls with an IP-SAN certificate. AGIC consumes the Store Ingress and its namespaced TLS Secret to reconcile Application Gateway. Dashed green paths represent control, not browser requests. Terraform bootstrap sre-lab-tls PFX is separate. AGIC is not an inline proxy.
